A respray is permanent and becomes part of the car's history. A wrap is a change for a few years that you can reverse. When it's time to sell, you can remove it and hand over the car in its original colour, with its factory paint intact.

We always choose the colour on your car, not from a catalogue on a desk. We place samples against the bodywork in daylight to see how the colour works with its curves. Matte can look premium on one model and flat on another. You only see the difference in person.

We use colour-change films from 3M and HEXIS. The exact film is listed in your quote, alongside the price and turnaround time.

The real value of PPF isn't extra shine. It's preserving the factory paint. Any paint thickness gauge will reveal a resprayed wing, and that can immediately reduce the price at a pre-purchase inspection. The film takes the impact instead of your clear coat: light scratches self-heal in the sun, while deeper ones stay in the film rather than reaching the paintwork.

We plotter-cut patterns for your specific model and hand-fit complex areas such as bumpers, mirrors and pillars. Wherever the panel allows, we wrap the edges around to the inside. This keeps dirt out of the edges and prevents that telltale thin grey line appearing a year later.

We use XPEL and SunTek films. At the inspection, before you approve the quote, we'll tell you exactly which film we recommend for your car.

Polishing removes a very thin layer of clear coat along with the scratches. There's only so much clear coat to work with, so we start with a paint thickness gauge, measuring every panel to assess the margin available. If the finish on the roof or wings is already thin, we take a gentler approach or leave that panel untouched.

Next come two or three polishing stages: a cutting compound removes the main defects, then a finishing polish removes machine-induced holograms. We check the result under a detailing light that reveals defects you wouldn't see outdoors. Only then do we degrease the surface and apply the ceramic coating. We polish with Koch-Chemie products and use Gtechniq ceramic coatings.

Another BMW X5 protected with clear **paint protection film (PPF)**. The film takes the damage that would otherwise reach the paintwork: stone chips, sand, insect residue and light scratches picked up during everyday driving. We also recommend protecting the headlights with PPF. Here are the benefits up front:
  • Protects the lenses from stones and road debris
  • Prevents scratches and pitting from sand
  • Filters UV rays to help keep the plastic from yellowing or turning cloudy
  • Keeps expensive LED and adaptive headlights looking factory-fresh
At the rear, the job is simpler:
  • Protects against scratches and minor damage
  • Keeps the rear lights clear and glossy for longer
Headlights are among the most vulnerable parts of a car. Stones, sand, dust, car wash brushes and sunlight gradually wear down the lenses. PPF adds a protective layer over the plastic, taking the brunt of that wear and impact. We can apply PPF to the entire car, just the front end, individual body panels or the lights alone.
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.55a87b1add801efd:
Još jedan BMW X5 zaštićen providnom **PPF folijom**. Folija štiti lak od onoga čemu je automobil svakodnevno izložen u vožnji: kamenčića, peska, tragova insekata i sitnih ogrebotina. Posebno preporučujemo zaštitu farova folijom. Evo šta ona pruža prednjim farovima:
  • štiti površinu od kamenčića i nečistoća sa puta
  • sprečava ogrebotine i oštećenja od peska
  • zadržava UV zrake, pa plastika duže ostaje bez žutila i zamućenja
  • čuva fabrički izgled skupih LED i adaptivnih farova
Kod zadnjih svetala zadatak je jednostavniji:
  • zaštita od ogrebotina i sitnih oštećenja
  • svetla duže ostaju providna i sjajna
Farovi su među najosetljivijim delovima automobila. Kamenčići, pesak, prašina, četke u auto-perionicama i sunce iz godine u godinu oštećuju njihovu površinu. Folija stvara dodatni zaštitni sloj između plastike i spoljašnjih uticaja, preuzimajući najveći deo oštećenja na sebe. Folijom se može zaštititi ceo automobil, samo prednji deo, pojedinačni delovi karoserije ili samo farovi i zadnja svetla.

This new 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLS came to us with two goals: protect the bodywork and give it a satin finish. Together with the owner, we chose a **190-micron** satin paint protection film for a full-body wrap. Under the film, the factory paint stays protected from minor scratches, stone chips, insect residue, road chemicals and grime. The satin finish changes the way light plays across the bodywork, while the original colour remains beneath the protective layer. Where technically possible, we tuck the film around panel edges. This leaves fewer visible edges, creates a more seamless finish and helps the film last longer. Film can be replaced locally. If one panel gets damaged during use, there is usually no need to rewrap the entire car, just replace the film on that panel. What a full-body wrap offers:
  • protection for factory paint against stone chips and minor scratches
  • a barrier that keeps road grime and chemicals off the paint
  • easier cleaning and maintenance
  • individual film replacement on damaged panels
  • protection for a new car from its very first kilometres
  • well-preserved factory paint when it is time to sell
  • a satin finish without repainting
We install paint protection film in Zvezdara, Belgrade. We can wrap both new and used cars, either in full or just the most vulnerable areas. We will help you choose the right film when we inspect the car. We will share the finished GLS satin PPF wrap once the work is complete.
src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.ecff98167f3a5834:
Novi Mercedes-Benz GLS 2026 stigao je kod nas sa dva zadatka: da zaštitimo karoseriju i damo joj satenski izgled. Zajedno sa vlasnikom odabrali smo satensku zaštitnu foliju debljine **190 mikrona**, kojom oblepljujemo celu karoseriju. Ispod folije fabrički lak ostaje netaknut: sitne ogrebotine, udarci kamenčića, ostaci insekata, so i hemikalije sa puta, kao i prljavština, više ne dolaze u direktan kontakt s njim. Satenska završnica menja način na koji automobil izgleda na svetlu, dok originalna boja ostaje ispod zaštitnog sloja. Gde god je to tehnički moguće, foliju podvlačimo preko ivica delova karoserije: spojevi su manje vidljivi, izgled je ujednačeniji, a folija duže traje. Folija može da se zameni i lokalno. Ako se tokom vožnje ošteti jedan deo karoserije, obično nema potrebe da se ponovo oblepljuje ceo automobil, već se folija menja samo na tom delu. Šta dobijate oblepljivanjem celog automobila:
  • fabrički lak zaštićen od oštećenja od kamenčića i sitnih ogrebotina
  • prljavština, so i hemikalije sa puta ostaju na foliji
  • lakše održavanje karoserije
  • mogućnost zamene folije samo na oštećenom delu
  • zaštitu novog automobila od prvih kilometara
  • očuvan fabrički lak, što se vidi i prilikom prodaje
  • satenski izgled bez farbanja
Oblepljivanje PPF folijom radimo u Beogradu, na Zvezdari. Folijom možemo zaštititi i nov i polovan automobil, u celosti ili samo najizloženije delove. Odgovarajuću foliju biramo prilikom pregleda vozila. Rezultat kompletnog oblepljivanja GLS-a satenskom folijom pokazaćemo kada završimo.

Providna zaštitna folija čuva originalnu boju i lak i štiti najizloženije delove od ogrebotina, sitnih oštećenja i prljavštine.

Folija u boji pruža istu zaštitu, a uz to menja izgled vozila. Možete izabrati novu boju, zanimljivu teksturu ili osmisliti potpuno personalizovan dizajn, a kada poželite promenu, zameniti foliju. Čak i svake godine.

Vozilo možete dovesti sami. Ako vam to ne odgovara, imamo **sopstveno vozilo i prikolicu**: dolazimo po vaš motocikl ili kvad, obavljamo posao i dogovaramo način vraćanja koji vam najviše odgovara.

Radimo na teritoriji Beograda i širom Srbije.

src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.53f4fb7688ec2019:
Toyota Yaris GR Sport naše klijentkinje iz Beograda. Automobil je kupljen polovan, ali u odličnom stanju, pa je nova vlasnica odlučila da odmah zaštiti karoseriju, pre nego što gradska vožnja ostavi prve tragove.

Yaris je kompaktan automobil za grad, a upravo u gradu karoserija najviše strada: tesna parking mesta kod prodavnica i tržnih centara, susedni automobili, neoprezno otvaranje vrata, kolica iz supermarketa, grane i kamenčići koje podižu točkovi. Posebno je neprijatno kada udubljenje ili oštećenje laka nastane samo zato što je neko na susednom parking mestu otvorio vrata malo više nego što je trebalo.

Zato smo celu karoseriju oblepili zaštitnom poliuretanskom folijom debljine **190 mikrona**.

PPF preko laka stvara čvrst, providan zaštitni sloj koji preuzima sitne ogrebotine, tragove trenja i lakših kontakata na parkingu, kao i udarce peska i kamenčića sa puta. Ova zaštita je posebno važna za vrata, blatobrane, branike i retrovizore, jer su stalno izloženi. Kvalitetna providna folija pritom je gotovo neprimetna, pa boja, sjaj i izgled karoserije ostaju nepromenjeni.

PPF ne pretvara automobil u oklopno vozilo i neće ga sačuvati od jakog udarca ili dubokog udubljenja. Ali štiti od svakodnevnih gradskih oštećenja zbog kojih lak već posle nekoliko godina izgleda istrošeno.

Yaris je iz našeg studija izašao sa istim fabričkim izgledom, ali sa karoserijom koja je sada mnogo spremnija za svakodnevni život u gradu.

src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.bbd2bb2dc15b887c:
This Toyota Yaris GR Sport belongs to a client from Belgrade. She bought it used but in excellent condition and decided to protect the bodywork straight away rather than wait for city driving to leave its first marks.

The Yaris is a compact car built for the city, but that is also where its bodywork takes the most punishment: tight parking spaces at shops and shopping centres, neighbouring cars, carelessly opened doors, supermarket trolleys, branches and stones kicked up by tyres. Few things are more frustrating than finding a dent or paint chip simply because someone parked next to you opened their door a little too wide.

We covered the entire body in **190-micron** polyurethane paint protection film.

PPF adds a tough, transparent layer over the clear coat, taking the brunt of minor scratches, scuffs, light parking scrapes, road grit and stone chips. Doors, wings, bumpers and mirrors benefit most, as they are constantly exposed. A quality clear film is almost invisible, preserving the car's original colour, gloss and appearance.

PPF does not make a car armoured and will not prevent damage from a heavy impact or a deep dent. But it does protect against the everyday wear that can leave paintwork looking tired after a couple of years in the city.

The Yaris left looking just as it did from the factory, only now its bodywork is far better prepared for daily city life.
